early.name: Quicksilver Reload
early.annotation: Adds hundreds of healing to each Scorn. Rush this before Monster Rounds if you are healthy enough to save. Start trying to Scorn the enemies as much as possible.

early.name: Trophy Collector
early.annotation: Sell if you need a slot late game, it does feel bad to lose the movespeed so I usually sell it for Enduring Speed and Juggernaut

mid.name: Torment Pulse
mid.annotation: Probably going to be one of your top damage source every game. I sometimes skip this if I am far behind. Get veilwalker first if you need to look for picks for the team

mid.name: Healbane
mid.annotation: good heal and good antiheal, not much more to say, higher rank you are less optional this becomes, (sellable)

mid.name: Superior Duration
mid.annotation: Great item that synergyzes with Burrow, Combo and Scourge. This is a Defensive and Offensive Spike.

mid.name: Phantom Strike
mid.annotation: A good item to buy the enemies are playing outside of Warp Stone+Dash Range constantly

late.name: Tankbuster
late.annotation: Buy earlier or later depending on if you can proc it (165 damage, 107 spirit power)

late.name: Arctic Blast
late.annotation: Buy this as soon as some loser on the enemy team thinks Indom is your hard counter

late.name: Escalating Exposure
late.annotation: Gives damage to whole team, and a little resist.

late.name: Boundless Spirit
late.annotation: with duration, it technically has 2.88x scaling, BUT after 1.5 seconds of burrow people can freely dash out of it, so its not worth it

late.name: Scourge
late.annotation: Use on yourself before using Combo, or use on an ally that is in a pinch.

late.name: Transcendent Cooldown
late.annotation: You can delay this for after Juggernaut/Scourge if you didn't buy Torment Pulse

picks.annotation: 谁家好人拿猪炸鱼啊

picks.name: Mystic Reverb
picks.annotation: 买这个干嘛啊

picks.name: Escalating Exposure
picks.annotation: 有这个你才有打持久战的资本，配合大大冷却的痛苦脉冲增伤，加上冰爆的增伤，加上1技能的增伤，我在等伤上加伤叠满你在等什么
